Smooth_Skin.description: Smooth_Skin, a sleek and iridescent membrane, clings to the slippery bodies of its amphibian and aquatic kin, offering a tactile experience that blends the crispness of water with the suppleness of skin. Its surface, dotted with minuscule scales, whispers secrets of the deep as it moves through currents, a testament to nature's artistry in form and function.

Slimy_Skin.description: Slimy_Skin: A mucus-covered, amphibious exterior that repels grapple attempts, slowly draining life essence from foes, leaving behind slippery slime trails.
